ui_intro: Yiwen n lfilm cwayt bla ṣṣut: kulci yella am aḍris di twalit. Tzemmreḍ ad tḥebseḍ ɣer kra n lweqt niɣ ad txtaṛeḍ aḥric.
k1_sub: Yiwen n lkaṛfuṛ. Bla lfiṛu, bla lpanuwat, bla lbulis.
k1_p1: Kraḍ n ṭumubilat ttasent-d di yiwen n lweqt. Maṛṛa xsent ad ṛuḥent nican.
k1_p3: Tiririt ad d-tas di taggara. Ixeṣṣa-c yiwet n tikti: tapiramit n lpriyuriti.
k2_intro: Yella yiwen n ttertib i yeqqimen. Win yellan ɣer ufella, yezwar.
s1_text: Tilɣa d tiwtilin n lbulis zwarent ɣer maṛṛa lqawaɛid, lfiṛu d lpanuwat.
s1_plus: Ḥetta dinni ixeṣṣa ad txẓeṛeḍ s yiman-nnec.
s2_text: Lfiṛu tezwar ɣer lpanuwat n lpriyuriti d ɣer lqaɛida n ufus.
s2_plus: Ḥetta s ḍḍew azegzaw ixeṣṣa ad txẓeṛeḍ.
s3_text: Ejj lpriyuriti, Stop, abrid n lpriyuriti: mani llan lpanuwat-a, lqaɛida n ufus war tetteddu ca.
s3_plus: Ad ten-tessneḍ s lcekl: lmutellet, lmutemmen, lmeɛin.
s4_text: Mala war llin ca win yellan ɣer ufella: win i d-itasen zi ufus ɣaṛ-s lpriyuriti.
s4_plus: Aya yetteddu di lkaṛfuṛ d di iberdan n yidis – d lasas.
k3_p1: Win i d-itasen zi ufus ɣaṛ-s lpriyuriti – di lkaṛfuṛ d di iberdan n yidis bla lpanuwat d bla lfiṛu.
k3_p2: Win ixeṣṣan ad iṛaǧu, ittsenqis ssuṛɛa zik. S waya kul yiwen ixeẓẓeṛ: ttṛaǧuɣ.
k3_p3: Ṭumubil i d-itasen zi ufus ɣaṛ-s lpriyuriti. Ṭumubil nniḍen tṛaǧa.
k3_p4: Tkemmleḍ ɣir mala war tessekcmeḍ nniḍen di lxaṭaṛ, war t-teḥbiseḍ aṭṭas.
k3_p5: Zi tama n zzat yetteddu ɛad aya: ḥetta dinni ɣaṛ-s lpriyuriti win i d-itasen zi ufus.
k3_p6: Axeṭṭa i yettɛawaden: war txẓaṛeḍ ca ɣer ufus niɣ ad tezwaṛeḍ bla ma ixeṣṣa.
k3_merk: Zi ufus ɛad ag izeggʷar, ɣir mala war yella ca win yellan ɣer ufella i yenna nniḍen.
k4_p1: Ssekker ligno zik, kcem ɣer tlemmast, xẓeṛ ɣer deffir.
k4_p2: Dɣa tṛaǧuḍ: ṭumubilat i d-yetteddun zzat-c zwarent.
k4_p3: Ṭumubilat n zzat i yetteddun nican: ejj-itent ad ɛeddint.
k4_p4: Ḥetta wid ittdewwiṛen ɣer ufus: ejj-itent ad ɛeddint.
k4_p5: Ɣir mala war tḥebbseḍ ca ḥedd, war tessekcmeḍ ca di lxaṭaṛ, ad tdewweṛeḍ.
k4_p6: Sin n wid ittdewwiṛen ɣer uzelmaḍ zi tama n zzat, ttdewwiṛen zzat wa i wa.
k4_p7: Ɣir mala lḥala n ubrid niɣ lkaṛfuṛ ssutren aya, ttdewwiṛen deffir wa i wa.
k4_merk: Wid ittdewwiṛen ɣer uzelmaḍ ttejjan ṭumubilat n zzat ad ɛeddint.
k5_p1: Lpanu 274.1: da tebda tamnaḍt n 30. Tzemmreḍ ad teddiḍ ɣir 30 km/h ugar.
k5_p2: Di tamnaḍt, di lkaṛfuṛ, di lqaɛida tetteddu zi ufus ɛad ag izeggʷar – aṭṭas n tikkal bla lpanuwat n lpriyuriti.
k5_p3: Ṭumubilat i yeqqimen ḥebsent-ac axẓaṛ? Qqeṛṛeb s ttawil, alami tẓaṛeḍ kulci.
k5_p4: Ddu s ttawil d qqim wajed i lfrinu – ḥetta mala ɣaṛ-c lpriyuriti.
k5_merk: Win i d-itasen zi ufus ɣaṛ-s lpriyuriti.
k6_a1: Ṭumubil n ufus di twalit tezwar: zi tama-s n ufus war d-yusi ca ḥedd.
k6_a2: Dɣa ṭumubil n lqaɛ: ṭumubil i d-itasen zi ufus tɛedda.
k6_a3: Taneggarut ṭumubil n uzelmaḍ: ḥetta dinni ṭumubil i d-itasen zi ufus tɛedda.
k6_merk: Win yellan ɣer ufella, yezwar. Mala war llin ca: zi ufus ɛad ag izeggʷar.
k6_b1: Ɣaṛ-sen lqawaɛid n yiman-nsen: ṛṛunpwan, tuffɣa zi lmilk, abrid n lḥeqlat d lɣaba.
k6_b2: Mala llan lbulis, lfiṛu niɣ lpanuwat, ten-ɣaṛ-sen lḥeqq ad zwaren – macci zi ufus ɛad ag izeggʷar.
k6_b3: Ṛux ṭṭeṛṛeb: tiswiriwin 3D n Fahr-Akademie ssknent-ak aya zi yal tama.
